{{Short description|American chemist}}
'''Kirk Sullivan Schanze''' is an American chemist previously at the [[University of Florida]] and currently the professor and Robert A. Welch Distinguished University Chair in Chemistry at the [[University of Texas at San Antonio]] and Editor-in-Chief of ''[[ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://fora.aa.ufl.edu/provost/IndependentFora/Distinguished-Professors |title=Distinguished Professors |publisher=University of Florida |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://pubs.acs.org/page/aamick/profile.html |title=Editors |publisher=ACS Publications |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://schanze.chem.ufl.edu/ |title=Lab |publisher=University of Florida |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.utsa.edu/chem/faculty/SchanzeLab/schanze.html |title=Kirk Schanze |publisher=The University of Texas at San Antonio |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=B1zG85EAAAAJ&hl=en |title=Kirk S. Schanze |publisher=Google Scholar |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ksc.kaust.edu.sa/Pages/2016-KAUST-Research-Conference-Speakers-Schanze.aspx|title=KAUST Solar Center-KAUST Research Conference 2016|website=ksc.kaust.edu.sa|language=en-US|access-date=2017-05-16}}</ref>
